episodes.title: Two Men Sentenced for Cult Involvement | Nigeria News
episodes.description: Two men, Moruf Okusanya and Babatunde Gafar, just got seven-year sentences each for conspiracy and involvement in illegal cult groups after a violent clash at Ikenne Town Hall. The court found their roles in the unrest — tied to the Eiye and Alora Confraternities — beyond doubt, sending a stern message that violence and unlawful organizations won't be tolerated. episodes.title: Anambra Police Bust Cult-Linked Weapons | Nigeria News
episodes.description: Anambra State Police nabbed two suspects during a high-speed chase after they ditched a plateless bike near Isuaniocha Bridge—turns out, they left behind two homemade pistols and Viking Confraternity caps, sparking fears of organized underground activity. Now the force is on full alert to track down the duo and uncover their network before things escalate. This bust is part of a broader crackdown aimed at keeping streets safe through proactive patrols and intelligence-led operations. episodes.title: Lagos Police Crack Down on Aiye Cult | Nigeria News
episodes.description: Lagos police strike hard against the Aiye Confraternity, arresting four key members—including a former chairman—in Mushin and Aganran, seizing a locally made Beretta pistol and ammo. The bust, triggered by one suspect's confession, led to three more arrests who claim the weapon came from a top figure named Rilwan. All four are now in custody aiding the probe as authorities vow to root out cult-related crime and urge the public to report suspicious activity. episodes.title: Ekiti Police Arrest Suspect in Cult Probe | Nigeria News
